notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
Fixes & Improvements

 Hides unit info in battles during tutorials
 Hides starter dice panel when sorting the units
 Updates re-roll prices to be based on total amount of items left
 Update small heal icon to be a smaller heart to contrast better with the half-heal icon

notes.title: Dicey Bugs is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
🐞🎲 Dicey Bugs is OUT NOW! 🎲🐞
The wait is over — Dicey Bugs has officially launched! It’s time to roll, capture, and conquer your way by controlling the battle in this bug-collecting adventure.

What’s waiting for you inside?

🪲 Capture & collect hundreds of adorable bugs

🎲 Customize every die to craft your perfect strategy

⚔️ Experiment with hundreds of builds — no two runs are the same

🛠️ Boost your power with equipment & consumables

🏆 Complete challenges to earn stamps and flex your progress

📺 Twitch integration for wild, chat-driven chaos

📊 Track your best runs and show off your stats

🎮 Steam Deck ready — play anywhere

♾️ Endless replayability where you control the run from the very first roll

🔥 Whether you’re here for the strategy, the chaos, or the cute-but-deadly critters, Dicey Bugs is ready to take over your game nights.

👉 Play now on Steam: Dicey Bugs

notes.title: Rolling Out Soon!
notes.content:
Releasing on September 12th @ 8am MST
DEMO & FULL GAME

Adds preview icons above units while hovering over specific actions.
[olist]
Dice: Shows which unit(s) will be healed, strengthened, have a status effect applied, etc.

Bottle: Shows which units can currently be caught or the target HP to make the them catchable.
[/olist]
Adds KO Rewards (bonus coins earned for defeating enemies in skillful ways like overkill, instakill, doublekill, etc)

Adds equipment that allows attacking a rear unit.

Coins and bottles will now be collected through equipment even when the battle is over.

Updates attack previews to only show if the unit will actually attack.

Updates the boss music.

Updates transitions between scenes.

Fixes a bug where KO'd units could still be interacted with under specific circumstances.

Fixes a bug where revive wasn't respecting percentage heals.

Fixes a bug where opponent targeting wasn't always working properly.

Fixes a bug where units weren't always receiving buffs in the correct order.

Fixes a bug where shop items were not always being deselected.

Fixes a bug where the Free Movement preview was remaining on.

Fixes a bug where scrolling while using controller was not always working.

Small fixes and updates for specific units (visuals, stats, abilities, habitats, etc).

FULL GAME

Adds Twitch Integration, allowing viewers to help or hinder the streamer (name bugs, give coins/bottles, prevent captures, apply buffs/debuffs, revive units, end the turn, etc).

Adds 3 new units and 1 new boss unit, along with their variants.

Updates the boss die faces for several bosses.

Fixes a bug where units that were converted to variants were losing their equipment.

Fixes a bug where units that were converted to variants were dropping low loot amounts.

Fixes a bug where Variant Starter Dice were not always being highlighted.

Fixes some steam achievements from being automatically triggered by Battle Hazards.

Adds new Steam achievements.

notes.title: Steam Deck Support!
notes.content:
STEAMDECK SUPPORT
Now you can capture all your favorite bugs and build your favorite team on the go!


Fixes & Updates
DEMO:

Adds a "Randomize Party" button to the Party Selection that chooses 3 random units from your collection.

Adds Spanish and Japanese languages.

Updates the names and/or icons for Ranged Attack, Support Attack, and Ambush actions for easier clarity and readability.

Allows unit positions to be swapped while in the shop.

Fixes a bug where KO, Ally KO, and Revive abilities were not always triggering correctly.

Fixes a bug where Lure was not always being removed if the unit is KO'd.

Fixes a bug where confusion previews were using STR rather than damage dealt.

Fixes some achievements that were not triggering correctly.

Updates supporters list.


FULL GAME:

Adds a new unit and variant.

Fixes "Fastest Run Time" stat not showing the correct time.

notes.title: Try the big demo update for Dicey Bugs, a turn-based deckbuilder where you control both sides
notes.content: Dicey Bugs is a roguelike, turn-based deckbuilder where you control both sides of the battles. A new demo is live now!Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/try-the-big-demo-update-for-dicey-bugs-a-turn-based-deckbuilder-where-you-control-both-sides/

notes.title: Demo 2.0.0
notes.content:
DemoFeatures
Adds the ability to save and continue a run.

Adds an exit shop button.

Field guide added.

New dice & consumables.

New battle backgrounds and music.

Ability to reset progression data.

Preview potential units before entering a battle.
Fixes & Improvements
Updates difficulty scaling.

Removes "Miss" feedback when using Idle dice.

Map graphics Overhaul.

Game menu Overhaul.

Fixes dead units from being allowed to become strengthened.


Full Game Progress
Adds Starter Dice (grants the ability to swap out 3 different die faces at the start of a run after they've been unlocked by completing runs). Not available in demo.

Adds Expert Mode (toggles run difficulty by modifying the bottle amount, shop prices, enemy dice, and enemy strength). Not available in demo.

Adds Battle Hazards (special battle events that trigger an effect on both parties each turn). Not available in demo.

Adds Steam Achievements. Not available in demo.

Enemies can spawn with equipment. Not available in demo.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.5
notes.content:
Fixes "Move" ability getting triggered when a unit is revived but the party did not move

Fixes the Start sfx playing twice when using controller on a brand new game

Adds leader icon to the map party

Updates some animations

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.2
notes.content:
Fixes UI getting cut off in 16:10 resolution.

Rearranges UI (settings button is now on the right)

Adds a preview icon to preview which unit will become the leader during movement.

Adds leader icons to the units in front.

Party members are no longer lost when ending a run from the Map scene.

Loot music has been updated.

Mixed rewards now always show up in the same order (dice, equipment, consumable)

Various small graphic & animation polishes and fixes.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
Adds new "Scare" action for die faces and consumables.

Adds tutorials for Player Party and Run Completed.

Adds tutorial titles to the tutorial boxes.

Adds a notification animation to the shop once you are able to purchase an item.

Adds navigation to show which map you're currently on.

Adds a tooltip to the speed settings.

Elite & Boss units now drop more coins.

Consumables are now limited to 5, rather than 10.

The consumables bar is now fully shown, regardless of how many you have.

The first ever dice roll is now predetermined to help teach players.

Coin rewards have been removed from the tutorial battle.

Player dice no longer get grayed out when they are ineffective.

The difficulty curve has been slightly modified.

Fixes a bug where the KO animation was not always playing correctly on fast mode.

Fixes controller support breaking during loot

Fixes consumables not triggering a "Miss" when the action is unusable

notes.title: Demo Version 1.0.10
notes.content:
Change Log[olist]
Updates enemy stats scaling for a better challenge

Updates map generation more interesting routes

Updates boss fights for an additional challenge

Unit stats have been re-balanced

Removes double and single unit battles in favor the more interesting three unit battles
[/olist]

Additions[olist]
Adds Elite Battles which offer a strong single unit battle with an additional challenge to overcome before they can be defeated

Adds a Tutorial Battle for first time players 




[/olist]
